work: Gregory M. Mathews, The Birds of Australia (London: Witherby & Co., 1910-1927), 12 vols + supplements, royal quarto
note: AUSTRALIAN RAVEN COMPLEX, not the little raven: this is Corvus coronoides (Australian raven), the same species as the existing Gould plate. No pre-1930 plate specifically of Corvus mellori was found.
copy: Museums Victoria copy, digitised for the Biodiversity Heritage Library (Internet Archive birdsaustraliaxiimath)
licence: Public domain (published 1925-1927; artist died 1940; BHL/IA: 'no longer under copyright protection')
processing: JP2 -> RGB, resized to 900 px tall (Lanczos), JPEG quality 85, no crop (tools/make_plate.py)
